title: remediation and style alignment
fixes: normalized user-facing presence status configurations, options, and guides to be entirely lowercase.
standardized jackpot embed titles, progressive rewards, headers, and announcements to follow lowercase rules.
lowercased rebirth command guide, requirements, items, and resetting logs.
standardized jackpot and rebirth colors to bronx::COLOR_WARNING pastel constant instead of raw 0xFFD700.

title: virtual stock market
fixes: added /market command (aliases: stocks, stock, shares, portfolio) for a fictional in-bot stock exchange.
implemented buy, sell, view, portfolio, and history subcommands with sparkline price charts.
stock prices fluctuate hourly with momentum, random delta, and 5% chance of bull run (+15-30%) or crash (-15-30%) events.
seeded 5 default companies (brnx, fish, mine, bjhd, amco) with distinct base prices.
renamed old /market server role shop to /smarket to free up the command namespace.
stock trades are tracked for daily challenge progress (stocks_traded stat).
portfolio view color-codes by net return: green for profit, red for loss.
integrated nlohmann_json dependency directly via CMake FetchContent to resolve compilation failures on environments lacking the library.

title: gear forging & socketing passive utility
fixes: implemented pickaxe and fishing rod gem forging and socketing under /forge.
integrated mining passive gem socket boosts for ruby, sapphire, emerald, diamond, topaz, and amethyst.
integrated fishing passive gem socket boosts for cooldowns, luck modifiers, crit multiplier, sell multipliers, and double catch.

title: fish command style normalization
fixes: standardized user-facing messages in fish.cpp to follow the lowercase branding guidelines.
replaced raw hex code 0xFFD700 in fish.cpp with bronx::COLOR_WARNING pastel constant.
integrated variety and attempt daily challenge hooks for fishing logs.

title: deployment TUI patch notes integration
fixes: added patch notes navigation tab to the deployment CLI console.
implemented scrolling through patch history using the w and s keys.
added json conflict checking and validation with a reload overlay in case of merge conflicts.

title: remediation & performance optimizations
fixes: offloaded last.fm commands (fm, ta, tt) key checks and api queries to background threads.
offloaded database-heavy mine command handler (do_mine) to detached background threads.
integrated daily challenge tracking hooks for wins, attempts, and variety across games.
removed block comments styling violations across utility commands.

title: deploy desktop TUI split pane
fixes: added side-by-side split log views for widescreen terminals.
implemented hjkl key navigation for earlier log window in pop-out view.
improved auto-scroll indicators and UI safeguards during tab switching.
